title: Created for Relationship
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Created for relationship means God made human beings to live before Him and with one another, not in isolated self-rule. Human relationships are part of God’s good design and must be shaped by love, truth, worship, and obedience.
summary: Created for relationship means God made human beings to live before Him and with one another, not in isolated self-rule. Human relationships are part of God’s good design and must be shaped by love, truth, worship, and obedience.
christFocus: Jesus Christ restores broken relationship with God and creates a redeemed people who belong to Him and to one another. In Christ, lonely and divided sinners are brought into the family of God.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
God created people for life with Him. Human beings are not accidents, isolated units, or self-made creatures. They are made by God, for God, and under God.

God also said it was not good for man to be alone. Human relationships are not a human invention added after creation; they belong to God’s design for life, help, love, stewardship, and community.

Sin distorts relationships by turning people inward toward pride, fear, domination, envy, lust, bitterness, and self-protection. Broken relationships reveal how deeply sin has damaged life before God.

Christ restores relationship first with God and then with others. His people are made members of one body and called to stir one another up to love, good works, worship, and faithful endurance.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people carry loneliness, rejection, betrayal, or isolation and begin to believe they were made to survive alone. Scripture teaches a better truth: people were created for life before God and for faithful love toward others.

This doctrine also challenges selfish independence. Relationships are not merely optional comforts; they are places where God teaches humility, service, patience, forgiveness, truth, and Christlike love.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive relationships as a gift and responsibility from God. Seek fellowship that strengthens faith, repent of selfish isolation, and let Christ teach you to love God and neighbor with humility, wisdom, and faithfulness.
